ComfyUI (core).aarch64: DGX Spark (aarch64): install PyTorch from the cu130 wheel index (NVIDIA DGX Spark ComfyUI playbook); fp8 and nvfp4 run (sm_121). Not run here on a Spark yet.

ComfyUI-KJNodes.aarch64: Python on top of PyTorch, no compiled wheels of its own: expected to work on aarch64 (UNVERIFIED on a Spark).

comfyui_controlnet_aux.aarch64: DWPose uses onnxruntime: onnxruntime-gpu has no aarch64 wheel, so install.sh adds the CPU onnxruntime and DWPose runs on the processor (NVIDIA DGX Spark ComfyUI troubleshooting page).

ComfyUI-segment-anything-2.aarch64: PyTorch only: expected to work on aarch64 (UNVERIFIED on a Spark).

ComfyUI-Frame-Interpolation.aarch64: RIFE is pure PyTorch and works on aarch64; the cupy-based models need a cupy build for aarch64 CUDA (UNVERIFIED).

ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler.aarch64: Not tested on aarch64 (UNVERIFIED); the native SeedVR2 graph uses core ComfyUI nodes instead.

ComfyUI-GGUF.note: Optional. Enables the lighter GGUF variants of large local models (the app checks for UnetLoaderGGUF). Not installed by nodes:install; add it in ComfyUI Manager.
ComfyUI-GGUF.aarch64: Python + the gguf package: works on aarch64 (UNVERIFIED on a Spark). Prefer the bf16 / fp8 files there: 128 GB fits them.
